## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Adoption should preserve the file when incoming values already match; it currently rewrites unchanged configuration. This review read both changed files and all existing tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption mode, records adopted keys, and adds tests for adoption and replacement updates.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:15 — correctness — Preserve file bytes when adoption changes no values — For a file containing `{"theme":"dark"}\n`, calling `merge(path, {"theme": "dark"}, adopt=True)` rewrites the file despite leaving its settings unchanged. The adoption branch unconditionally appends the key, triggering `write_text` and replacing the original formatting. This breaks the module’s stated preservation behavior; the tests cover unchanged replacement but only changed-value adoption. — Users lose existing formatting and receive a file modification when adopting an identical value. — Fix: Track actual value changes separately from adopted keys so you can report adoption without writing unchanged settings.
